pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: lib/claudeCli.ts:161 Both spawn doors (the reasoning door's spawnTurn and the agent seam's runAgent, which import seatOnlyEnv) build the child's environment by copying process.env and deleting four ANTHROPIC_* names. No CLAUDE*-family identifier is scrubbed by prefix, so a nested headless `claude` inherits whatever session identifiers the parent runtime put in the environment, which is the per-site enumeration the nested-run technique names as the failure.

techniques.evidence: lib/claudeCli.ts:161 The scrub enumerates four metered-auth names and is not a family/prefix scrub with add-back by name. A grep of lib/agent, lib/turns and lib/claudeCli.ts finds no CLAUDECODE or CLAUDE_CODE_ removal. The reasoning door's cliArgs (claudeCli.ts:279-287) also omits --safe-mode, so user-wide hooks still fire from that child. The agent seam does pass --safe-mode.

lib/turns/ledger.ts:302 The boot sweep closes a live record whose owner process is gone with its own `orphaned` status. That is not failed and not done, and the turn is never re-dispatched (ledger.ts:288-293).

lib/agent/cliSeam.ts:59 The tool allowlist is a constant in host code, enforced in agentArgs.ts:25 and passed as argv. It is not read from the agent's workspace, and --restricted ignores project settings files.
lib/agent/agentArgs.ts:44 Agent turns keep no durable conversation state to checkpoint or resume. Each turn is one-shot, and the turn ledger stores the validated result, not the conversation.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: lib/articles/drive.ts:137 When a dead driver left a step `running`, the next walk overwrites that record with a fresh `running` record and a new startedAt, carrying only costUsd that a finished attempt reported. The interrupted, side-effecting agent turn is therefore never closed with an indeterminate result in run.json, and its spend never reaches the step's cost.

techniques.evidence: lib/articles/drive.ts:137 step() checks only prior.status === "done". A stale `running` prior is reopened silently, and StepStatus (types.ts:63) has only running|done|failed. resumeRun (resume.ts:39) returns such a run 'as it stands' with no closure.

lib/articles/agentSteps.ts:27 Each step's tool list and timeout are host-code constants. The agent runs in a fresh tmpdir workspace (agentSteps.ts:36) that holds only inputs/ and out/, so it cannot edit its own policy.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: lib/articles/registryWrite.ts:80 The gate's only child processes are deterministic git/gh calls (registryWrite.ts:80) and a diff (diffFiles.ts:31). A grep of the eight files for spawn, runAgent and claude finds no agent run, and a grep of all of lib/articles for registerHook, plugin, checkpoint, safe-mode and registerTool finds nothing, so no runtime is assembled, extended or checkpointed here.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/store.ts:3 This context is the disk layer over runs the Python forge writes, plus the verdict log, commit planning and calibration. A grep of lib/foundry finds no registerHook, plugin, checkpoint or safe-mode, and none of the context's ten files spawns or calls runAgent or claude, so no agent runtime is assembled here.
